results.description:
uBO Lite (uBOL) is a reliable and efficient content blocker.

The default ruleset corresponds to uBlock Origin's default filterset:

- uBlock Origin's built-in filter lists
- EasyList
- EasyPrivacy
- Peter Lowe’s Ad and tracking server list

You can enable more rulesets by visiting the options page -- click the _Cogs_ icon in the popup panel.

uBOL is entirely declarative, meaning there is no need for a permanent uBOL process for the filtering to occur, and CSS/JS injection-based content filtering is performed reliably by the browser itself rather than by the extension. This means that uBOL itself does not consume CPU/memory resources while content blocking is ongoing -- uBOL's service worker process is required _only_ when you interact with the popup panel or the option pages.

Nomoads blocks ads, trackers and unwanted domains in apps, games and Safari, right on your iPhone and iPad.

It works at the DNS level: when an app tries to reach a known ad or tracking server, Nomoads stops the request before it connects. Turn it on with one tap and it keeps working in the background.

WHY PEOPLE USE NOMOADS
• Fewer ads in apps, games and websites
• Stop trackers that follow you from app to app
• Block known scam, phishing and gambling domains
• See what was blocked, domain by domain

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Filtering happens on your device
• No account needed
• Nomoads never sees or stores your browsing history
• Your traffic does not pass through Nomoads servers

Nomoads uses the iOS VPN permission only to filter DNS locally. It does not change your IP address or location.

FEATURES
• Protection levels from Relaxed to Ultimate
• Advanced lists: scams, gambling, adult content, social networks, intrusive overlays
• Custom filter lists and your own blocked domains
• Allowlist for sites you trust
• Live stats and a full query log
• Home Screen widget

FREE & PREMIUM
Start free with up to 1,000 blocks per day. Premium removes the daily limit and unlocks stronger protection levels, advanced and custom lists, and 30-day stats history.

GOOD TO KNOW
Some ads come from the same servers as the content itself (for example, video ads inside YouTube), and DNS filtering cannot remove those. iOS allows only one active VPN at a time.

results.description:
Canopy Sieve gives Safari four dedicated content-blocking extensions that work together to remove ads, block trackers, stop malware, and hide cookie notices, without slowing down your browser or draining your battery.

WHAT GETS BLOCKED
• Ads, banner ads, video pre-rolls, sponsored posts, and ad scripts from thousands of known ad networks
• Trackers & Analytics, third-party tracking pixels, fingerprinting scripts, and analytics beacons that follow you across the web
• Malware & Phishing, known malicious domains, phishing pages, and harmful redirects
• Annoyances, cookie consent popups, social media share widgets, and newsletter nag screens

HOW IT WORKS
Canopy Sieve uses Safari's built-in Content Blocker API. Your browsing never passes through a VPN or proxy, blocking happens entirely on your device, so your data stays private and your connection stays fast.

FOUR EXTENSIONS, MAXIMUM COVERAGE
Safari limits each content blocker to 150,000 rules. Canopy Sieve uses four coordinated extensions to deliver over 400,000 blocking rules, far more than any single-extension blocker can offer.

ALLOWLIST
Added a site that doesn't work? Tap Allowlist and enter the root domain (e.g. example.com) to let it through. Changes apply instantly without re-downloading anything.

AUTOMATIC UPDATES
Blocklists refresh silently in the background so you're always protected against the latest ad networks and trackers, no action needed.

PRIVACY FIRST
Canopy Sieve contains no analytics, no crash reporting, and no account system. The only network requests it makes are to download blocklist updates from its own open-source list server.

SUPPORT THE PROJECT
Canopy Sieve is free. If it saves you from ads every day, consider leaving a tip from inside the app, it directly supports continued development and list maintenance.
